SpaceX scrubbed today's launch attempt of the Starlink 15-15 mission prior to the start of fueling. The new target for flight from California is now during a window that opens at 2:59 p.m. PDT (5:59 p.m. EDT / 2159 UTC). It appears teams ran into a technical issue.

Mission

Another T-0 change for the Starlink 15-15 mission. SpaceX is now targeting 5:06 p.m. PDT (8:06 p.m. EDT / 0006 UTC) for the launch of its Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base. Our live coverage will begin 30 minutes prior to liftoff.
